name: WF-100 — Telegram local intake (INATIVO ATE CUTOVER)

parameters.query:
-- Ingestão segura em channel_updates e channel_inbound_events via RPC SECURITY DEFINER
SELECT accepted, persisted, duplicate, queued, update_id
FROM ingest_channel_update(
  $1::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text,
  $6::text, $7::boolean, $8::jsonb, $9::text, $10::text,
  $11::text, $12::text
);
